rules.justification: IKW gives NEXP=MA; MA contained in NEXP is already known.
Theorem 3.5 with trivial oracles gives P^#P contained in MA. PP and PH are contained in P^#P (the latter by Toda, explicitly used in Section 3.4).
The reverse direction of the IKW equivalence. MA is unconditionally contained in NEXP, so the premise gives NEXP=MA.
Baseline QMA⊆PP turns PP⊆QMA into equality. No relativization or promise-oracle substitution.
Use CeqP⊆PP to obtain equality. PP complement closure then gives coCeqP=PP, exactly the corollary premise.

Only oracle class CeqP is replaced by AWPP. UP^AWPP⊆AWPP is an unconditional theorem. Exact-count construction D1 also gives PP and parityP endpoints. See derivation D1 in research/audit-round2-cross-counting.md.

WPP⊆CeqP and the premise identify WPP=CeqP. Complement closure gives coCeqP=WPP. Therefore UP^CeqP⊆UP^WPP⊆coCeqP=WPP. D1 adds PP and parityP. No claim P^WPP=WPP is needed. See derivation D1 in research/audit-round2-cross-counting.md.
UP⊆CeqP is baseline. The hypothesis makes CeqP=UP, explicitly one of the equivalent conditions used by the proof. The PP, PH and parityP conclusions are all stated in condition (4).

C=·CeqP⊆CeqP^CeqP is unconditional operator-to-oracle simulation. The hypothesis replaces only the oracle, giving CeqP^LWPP=CeqP by established LWPP lowness for CeqP. Hence PP⊆LWPP. P^LWPP=LWPP then transports PH and parityP from P^PP. The argument does not use the unproved LWPP^LWPP=LWPP.

Discharged by D1: PP⊆UP^CeqP. Replace the oracle by parityP, then use the unconditional relativizing UP⊆parityP and parityP^parityP=parityP. This avoids relativizing the hypothesis CeqP⊆parityP. See derivation D1 in research/audit-round2-cross-counting.md.
PH⊆UP^CeqP⊆UP^coNP⊆NP^coNP=NP^NP=Sigma2P. Complementing each query swaps coNP and NP; no NP=coNP assumption. The 2026 source is corroboration, not necessary to admission.
Delta2P=P^NP⊆P^SPP=SPP. The latter equality is unconditional closure under polynomial-time Turing reductions. No measure hypothesis needed for Delta2P; PH would need an additional argument.
Delta2P=P^NP⊆P^LWPP=LWPP. FFK explicitly states SPP^LWPP=LWPP and therefore Turing closure. Do not replace this by LWPP self-lowness.
P^AWPP⊆UP^AWPP⊆AWPP and reverse containment uses one oracle query. Replace NP only in oracle position.

Classical adaptive oracle calls can each be simulated with error at most 1/(100q(n)); a union bound across q(n) queries gives bounded error. No coherent oracle theorem is required for P^BQP⊆BQP. Total-language correctness on every query is essential.
Delta2P=P^NP⊆P^parityP=parityP. Only the oracle changes.
Theta2P=P_parallel^NP. The query list is unchanged when the same total NP oracle is regarded as a WPP language. WPP truth-table closure suffices; unrestricted Turing closure is not asserted.

First amplify the outer BP reduction to error≤1/12 using parityP closure under deterministic oracle reductions; then answer its total parity language by BPP with error≤1/12. The resulting success gap is at least 5/6 versus 1/6, hence BPP.
As in the BPP case, amplify the outer BP reduction and the BQP decision subroutine before composition. Classical randomness is available in BQP; the target parity language is total.
Both target languages lie in P^PP, replace PP by AWPP, and use P^AWPP=AWPP.
Both target languages lie in P^PP. Replace the PP oracle and use amplified classical adaptive BQP subroutine simulation.
P^PP⊆P^parityP=parityP. Remove the second submitted conclusion parityP⊆parityP: it is reflexive and contributes no consequence.
PH and parityP lie in P^PP. Replace the oracle by SPP and invoke P^SPP=SPP.
PH and parityP lie in P^PP. Replace the oracle by LWPP and invoke P^LWPP=LWPP, not LWPP^LWPP=LWPP.

Discharged by D2, which only needs the exact-count language in A0PP. CeqP⊆QMA and QMA⊆A0PP supply that. Common encoded query length makes the amplified threshold independent of the guessed count. Nonnegative gaps prevent cancellations and a polynomially large exponent defeats all wrong guesses. Apply the same argument to parityP∈P^#P[1] for the second endpoint. See derivation D2 in research/audit-round2-cross-counting.md.

complement_pairs.justification: From a 0/1 GapP gap g, use 1−g.
Replace gap g by f(0^|x|)−g; the length-dependent normalizer is unchanged.
Replace gap g by f(x)−g; the FP normalizer is unchanged.
Replace approximating gap g by f−g to exchange the near-zero and near-one intervals.
If membership means integer GapP gap g>0, then 1−2g>0 holds exactly on nonmembers.
Replace GapP gap g by g+1 to exchange odd and even parity.
Flip the output bit, exchanging bounded-error acceptance and rejection.
HVSZK is closed under complement and equals SZK; Section 1 credits Okamoto and Sahai–Vadhan for the complement theorem.
coMA is defined as the set of complements of MA languages.
coAM is defined as the set of complements of AM languages.
coQMA is defined as the set of complements of QMA languages; this is not a claim QMA=coQMA.

notes: Historical review is recorded in research/baseline-audit.json and the versioned audit dossiers. Decisions about open status are evidence-based, revisable judgments; neither the relation closure nor a negative search proves absence of all pre-cutoff results.
No unrelativized strict separation between BQP and BPP, NP and BQP, or QMA and QCMA is seeded. Oracle results do not resolve those ordered pairs.

A promise-class inclusion restricts to a total-language inclusion. A separation witnessed only by a promise problem need not yield a total-language separation. The benchmark currently misses that second type of result.
BPP=P for total languages does not by itself permit replacing a verifier's promise-BPP problem by a P machine. In particular this file does not encode BPP=P implies MA=NP or QCMA=NP.
The q-gsv99 equivalence between NISZK=BPP and SZK=BPP is explicitly for promise classes and is not encoded for the total-language roster.
Neither SBP nor CeqP is assigned self-complement closure. Their complement closure is not known here; this is not a proven nonclosure.
parityP contained in PP is not a known seed. Exact parity and a threshold are different counting conditions.
Do not encode BPP=P implies NEXP not contained in Ppoly: Kabanets–Impagliazzo gives a disjunction with an arithmetic circuit lower bound, which this pair-only rule language cannot express.

The nonuniform circuit convention is essential. Nonuniform AC0 already contains undecidable length languages and must not be included in P or L. Its known reverse separations from all decidable roster classes should be provided by the classical baseline.

All source years are document/publication years, not the search engine's sometimes misleading crawl or republication date. Later revisions require a pinned historical-version audit before eligibility is frozen.
